'''Johan Van der Meer Ralltiir Operations''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Johan Van der Meer]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds63.htm Ralltiir Operations], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228055123/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds63.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Johan Van der Meer]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
